data.heading: What you will learn
data.subheading: Eight weeks, four modules, one finished project.

items.question: Foundations
items.answer: Core concepts, tooling setup and your first working prototype. You will ship something small in week one.

items.question: Data and state
items.answer: Model real data, handle forms and keep your interface in sync as it changes.

items.question: Testing and quality
items.answer: Write automated tests, catch regressions early and review code like a professional.

items.question: Launch
items.answer: Deploy, monitor and improve your project, then present it to a panel of working engineers.
